name: researchhub-monorepo
description: ResearchHub OS - Monorepo for Cloud-Native Research Management Platform

scripts.deploy:gateway: gcloud builds submit . --config=cloudbuild.yaml --substitutions="_SERVICE_NAME=gateway,_IMAGE_TAG=us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/research-hub-lab2-5/researchhub-repo/service-gateway:latest" --project=research-hub-lab2-5 --quiet && gcloud run deploy rh-gateway --image="us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/research-hub-lab2-5/researchhub-repo/service-gateway:latest" --region=us-central1 --project=research-hub-lab2-5 --quiet
scripts.deploy:lab: gcloud builds submit . --config=cloudbuild.yaml --substitutions="_SERVICE_NAME=lab,_IMAGE_TAG=us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/research-hub-lab2-5/researchhub-repo/service-lab:latest" --project=research-hub-lab2-5 --quiet && gcloud run deploy rh-lab --image="us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/research-hub-lab2-5/researchhub-repo/service-lab:latest" --region=us-central1 --project=research-hub-lab2-5 --memory=1Gi --timeout=120s --quiet
scripts.deploy:dataset: gcloud builds submit . --config=cloudbuild.yaml --substitutions="_SERVICE_NAME=dataset,_IMAGE_TAG=us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/research-hub-lab2-5/researchhub-repo/service-dataset:latest" --project=research-hub-lab2-5 --quiet && gcloud run deploy rh-dataset --image="us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/research-hub-lab2-5/researchhub-repo/service-dataset:latest" --region=us-central1 --set-env-vars="GCS_BUCKET=research-hub-lab2-5-storage,STORAGE_BUCKET=research-hub-lab2-5-storage,STORAGE_DRIVER=gcs" --project=research-hub-lab2-5 --quiet
scripts.deploy:document: gcloud builds submit . --config=cloudbuild.yaml --substitutions="_SERVICE_NAME=document,_IMAGE_TAG=us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/research-hub-lab2-5/researchhub-repo/service-document:latest" --project=research-hub-lab2-5 --quiet && gcloud run deploy rh-document --image="us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/research-hub-lab2-5/researchhub-repo/service-document:latest" --region=us-central1 --set-env-vars="GCS_BUCKET=research-hub-lab2-5-storage,STORAGE_BUCKET=research-hub-lab2-5-storage,STORAGE_DRIVER=gcs" --project=research-hub-lab2-5 --quiet
scripts.deploy:experiment: gcloud builds submit . --config=cloudbuild.yaml --substitutions="_SERVICE_NAME=experiment,_IMAGE_TAG=us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/research-hub-lab2-5/researchhub-repo/service-experiment:latest" --project=research-hub-lab2-5 --quiet && gcloud run deploy rh-experiment --image="us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/research-hub-lab2-5/researchhub-repo/service-experiment:latest" --region=us-central1 --set-env-vars="GCS_BUCKET=research-hub-lab2-5-storage,STORAGE_BUCKET=research-hub-lab2-5-storage,STORAGE_DRIVER=gcs" --project=research-hub-lab2-5 --quiet
